IDA_IDAPython.description: IDA automation via idat64/idat/ida64/ida.exe with configurable script path. Supports .py/.ps1/.bat/.cmd/.exe scripts. Evidence output as JSON with strings, candidates, compare contexts, constraint contexts.

material_evidence_support.instruction_confirmed_base64: partial — can extract strings and candidates, but no dedicated Base64 construction point evidence kind
material_evidence_support.instruction_confirmed_rc4: partial — same as above, no dedicated RC4 KSA/PRGA evidence kind
material_evidence_support.utf16le_expansion: not_applicable — IDA static extraction does not produce UTF-16LE constructor evidence

Ghidra.description: No Ghidra integration found in codebase. No Ghidra script directory, no Ghidra executable resolver, no Ghidra evidence converter.

OllyDbg.description: OllyDbg integration exists with executable/script resolution, subprocess execution, and JSON evidence ingestion. Preflight check separates backend_ready from runtime_ready. Two audit scripts documented: compare_handoff_post_entry_step_audit.py and compare_handoff_narrower_post_entry_breakpoint_audit.py.

material_evidence_support.instruction_confirmed_base64: partial — compare_aware_search.py references pre_rc4_material_probe.py, base64_rc4_breakpoint_probe.py, base64_rc4_static_point_discovery.json, but these are strategy-level orchestration, not direct evidence kinds in tool_runners
material_evidence_support.instruction_confirmed_rc4: partial — same as Base64, strategy has RC4-specific probe scripts but tool_runners evidence converter does not have dedicated RC4 KSA/PRGA kind
material_evidence_support.utf16le_expansion: partial — transforms/samplereverse.py handles UTF-16LE encoding/decoding, but no dedicated UTF-16LE constructor evidence kind in StructuredEvidence

x64dbg_debugger.description: No x64dbg integration found. Only OllyDbg is supported for Windows dynamic debugging.

strings_file_objdump_radare2.description: Static string extraction is supported within IDA evidence output (strings field). No standalone strings/objdump/radare2 tool runner exists.

tool_runners.description: Centralized tool automation with ToolAutomationConfig, ToolRunArtifact, run_tool_automation(), run_ida_evidence(), run_compare_probe(), and OllyDbg execution. Evidence conversion from JSON to StructuredEvidence is unified.

material_evidence_support.instruction_confirmed_base64: partial — unified converter lacks dedicated Base64/RC4/UTF-16LE material kinds

StructuredEvidence.description: Single evidence dataclass with kind, source_tool, summary, payload, confidence, derived_candidates. Kinds are string-based, not enum-based, allowing extension.

material_evidence_support.instruction_confirmed_base64: partial — kind is extensible but no 'Base64MaterialEvidence' or 'RC4MaterialEvidence' kind exists yet

artifact_registration_provenance_freshne.description: project_state.py handles artifact indexing, freshness tracking, provenance, and round manifest archiving. artifact_index.json tracks current/missing/stale artifacts.

material_evidence_support.instruction_confirmed_base64: not_applicable — metadata layer, not evidence kind

gaps_found.description: StructuredEvidence has no dedicated kind for instruction-confirmed Base64 construction points. Current workaround: Base64/RC4 material is stored in RuntimeCompareEvidence or CandidateEvidence payload, losing semantic specificity.

StructuredEvidence has no dedicated kind for instruction-confirmed RC4 KSA/PRGA points. compare_aware_search.py orchestrates RC4 probes but the evidence converter does not ingest them as first-class structured evidence.
transforms/samplereverse.py handles UTF-16LE encoding but no evidence kind captures UTF-16LE expansion or constructor points from runtime.

No Ghidra integration exists. For samplereverse, IDA + OllyDbg + CompareProbe are the primary tools. Ghidra would be useful for cross-platform or headless automation but is not critical for the current Windows GUI sample.
gaps_found.proposed_action: Defer until non-Windows sample or headless SRE need arises

gaps_found.description: Only OllyDbg is supported for Windows dynamic debugging. x64dbg is a modern alternative but not required for current samplereverse workflow.
gaps_found.proposed_action: Defer until OllyDbg compatibility issue or modern debugger feature need arises

gaps_found.description: compare_aware_search.py references pre_rc4_material_probe.py, base64_rc4_breakpoint_probe.py, compare_producer_material_confirmation.py, material_hook_runtime_validation.py in olly_scripts/, but tool_runners.py only has generic _run_ollydbg() and compare_probe(). The material-specific probe orchestration lives in the strategy, not in the tool runner layer.
gaps_found.proposed_action: Consider moving material-probe orchestration to a dedicated MaterialProbeRunner or extending ToolAutomationConfig with material_probe_enabled flag

gaps_found.description: run_compare_probe() captures runtime compare data (lhs_wide_hex, rhs_wide_hex, input_text) but does not confirm which instructions perform Base64/RC4/UTF-16LE operations. It is a black-box runtime probe, not an instruction-level material probe.
gaps_found.proposed_action: Combine compare_probe with OllyDbg single-step material probe to get instruction-level confirmation

duplicate_interface_risks.description: Low risk. IDA runner is centralized in tool_runners.py. No duplicate IDA interfaces found.
Low risk. OllyDbg runner is centralized in tool_runners.py::_run_ollydbg(). Preflight is separate but complementary (configuration probe vs execution).
Low risk. run_compare_probe() is the single CompareProbe entry point. compare_aware_search.py calls it directly.

Medium risk. _structured_evidence_from_json() is the single converter, but material-specific probe scripts may produce JSON schemas it does not recognize, leading to ad-hoc parsing in compare_aware_search.py.
duplicate_interface_risks.mitigation: Extend _structured_evidence_from_json() with material-specific branches or create dedicated material evidence converters

material_evidence_bottleneck_mapping.current_bottleneck: Base64/RC4/UTF-16LE material construction evidence is missing or unresolved

existing_interface_coverage.instruction_confirmed_base64_constructio: partial — IDA can find strings and candidates; OllyDbg can step through; but no unified evidence kind captures 'this instruction at 0xXXXX is a Base64 encode step'
existing_interface_coverage.instruction_confirmed_rc4_ksa_prga_point: partial — OllyDbg scripts exist for material probing but evidence is not converted to StructuredEvidence
existing_interface_coverage.utf16le_expansion_or_constructor_evidenc: partial — transforms/samplereverse.py models the encoding but runtime constructor evidence is not captured
existing_interface_coverage.compare_producer_hooks_as_leads: implemented — CompareProbe captures compare sites and inputs; these are used as leads for material hook candidates in compare_aware_search.py

material_evidence_bottleneck_mapping.recommended_next_integration_step: Extend StructuredEvidence with Base64MaterialEvidence, RC4MaterialEvidence, and UTF16LEMaterialEvidence kinds, and update _structured_evidence_from_json() to ingest material probe JSON outputs from OllyDbg scripts. Do not add new tool runners (IDA/OllyDbg already exist). Do not add Ghidra/x64dbg yet.

recommended_next_decision_scope: Add dedicated material evidence kinds to StructuredEvidence and update the JSON evidence converter in tool_runners.py to support Base64/RC4/UTF-16LE material probe outputs from existing OllyDbg scripts. No new external tools. No sample execution.
